fact: South Sudan's 2026 Countdown synthesis reports DHIS2 monthly facility reporting completeness rising from 62% in 2020 to 73% in 2025, with 24% of districts at or above 90% completeness in 2025.
title: Analysis of Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health Indicators for 2022-2025: South Sudan
publisher: Ministry of Health South Sudan / Countdown to 2030
